objective: Characterize the exact motif-free V+D k3 obstruction against the motif-bearing H k3 channel, using the already represented transition/residual anatomy without inventing a new feature.
rationale: EW-019 cleanly partitions the two inclusion-minimal k3 obstruction channels: H is motif-bearing, V+D is motif-free.
The V+D channel contains one contradictory reconvergence and ten nonzero fundamental cycles.
A single exact characterization can reveal whether its endpoint residual distinction is qualitatively different and whether another already represented DTS role is load-bearing.
targeted_observations: shortest contradictory route lengths and edge deltas
motif coverage already fixed by EW-019
open_observation_channel: Preserve any endpoint residual pattern or transition distinction not anticipated by the H-channel model.
anti_circularity: no new classifier is fit in this experiment
the channels and broad motif were fixed before this characterization
raw canonical mask numbers remain provenance, not invariant identities
stopping_rule: After characterizing the V+D contradiction, stop experimental search unless the observation itself exposes one sharply defined, independently testable structural relation. Do not invent a bespoke motif solely from one witness.
